create_render_layer: create a RenderLayer module with height, width, vertex indices, UV coordinates, and UV triangle indices for mesh rasterization
render_meshes_forward: render 3D meshes by passing vertices, textures, camera intrinsics K, and extrinsics Rt through the RenderLayer forward pass
rasterize_with_pytorch3d: rasterize textured 3D meshes using PyTorch3D MeshRasterizer with UV texture mapping and camera projection
sample_mesh_textures: sample UV textures from 3D mesh fragments and return rendered RGB images with background masking
review_render_layer_class: review the RenderLayer class to understand mesh rasterization, UV texture sampling, and camera projection logic
